subject: LumenAI — Post-call recap and decision checklist
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Shah <arjun@lumenai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumenAI — Post-call recap and decision checklist

Hi Arjun,

Thanks for your time today — appreciate the clear breakdown of the inference pain and goals. Quick recap so we have alignment and a proposed decision checklist for your team to review. I kept this intentionally short; I attached an editable checklist that maps owners and dates.

Key pain we heard
- Latency spikes on 4k+ concurrent requests during business hours (models hosted today are CPU-bound).
- Cost-per-request variability when traffic bursts hit (cache miss patterns).
- KV-cache cold-starts when routing between regions (affects user experience).

Goals you outlined
- 75% reduction in tail latency for customer-facing calls (p90 target).
- Predictable unit cost within 20% month-over-month.
- Pilot in prod-like environment with 100K monthly API calls.

Proposed decision checklist / milestones (first pass)
1) Technical discovery & lab validation — owner: Arjun (LumenAI) / Sergio (Redwood) — target: 2027-09-30 — acceptance: baseline latency/cost benchmark recorded
2) PoC (2 weeks) — owner: Arjun — target start: 2027-10-03 — acceptance: demo with 50K calls and KV-cache retention verified
3) Pilot (6 weeks) — owner: Priya (ML Ops) / Monica (Redwood CS) — target start: 2027-10-17 — acceptance: production traffic mirror at 100K calls
4) Contracting & procurement sign-off — owner: Rahul Menon (LumenAI procurement) / Priyom (Redwood sales ops) — target: 2027-11-01
5) Production rollout & SLA handover — owner: Priya — target: 2027-11-15

Open items / asks for your team
- Confirm owners above and whether Rahul is the correct procurement contact (we noted Rahul on the call).
- Security/compliance: Are you able to share the SOC2 questionnaire this week so we can line up the security review?
- Procurement timeline: is early-November realistic for an internal sign-off?

Attachments: redwood-lumenai-pilot-checklist.xlsx (editable) — I put a column for "must-have" vs "nice-to-have" and an initial estimate of effort.

If this looks right, reply with any owner/date tweaks and I’ll update the checklist and circulate a final MAP (mutual action plan) doc.

Thanks again — big potential to reduce cost and stabilize latency for you.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Subject: Re: LumenAI — Post-call recap and decision checklist

Thanks, Sergio — this matches our discussion well. A couple of quick updates from our side:

- Owners: Confirming Priya (ML Ops) will lead the pilot, Rahul Menon (rahul@lumenai.com) will own procurement — he was on the extended call but not listed in your cc.
- Dates: PoC start can be 2027-10-04 (shift by one day to accommodate internal sprint close). Pilot start: 2027-10-18.
- Security: we will need a short turnaround on the SOC2 answers — I can share the internal SOC2 nexus with you (redacted) by EOD tomorrow.

Quick note on acceptance criteria: For the pilot we need a clear SLA for p95 latency (not just p90) since our SLAs to customers require p95 guarantees. Can Redwood include p95 targets in the pilot acceptance?

I’m looping Priya and Rahul here — Priya, Rahul: Sergio will own the PoC logistics from Redwood; we’ll need to confirm access for a mirrored traffic run and define throttling thresholds.

—
Arjun Shah
Director, Machine Learning Engineering

Subject: LumenAI — Updated decision checklist & next actions (please confirm)

Arjun / Priya / Rahul —

Per Arjun and Monica’s updates, I adjusted the MAP and attached an updated checklist and a short SOW draft. Summary of agreed updates below; please confirm owners and the dates so we can lock the plan into HubSpot and start resource allocation.

Confirmed stakeholders
- Arjun Shah — Dir, ML Eng (technical owner for PoC)
- Priya Sharma — Head, ML Ops (pilot & production sign-off)
- Rahul Menon — Procurement (contract & purchase order)
- Sergio Alvarez — Redwood (PoC & commercial coordination)
- Monica Patel — Redwood CS (pilot runbook, success criteria)

Finalized milestones & targets (updated)
1) Technical discovery & lab validation — owner: Arjun / Sergio — due: 2027-09-30 — deliverable: benchmark report (baseline latency & cost)
2) PoC (2 weeks) — owner: Arjun — start: 2027-10-04 — deliverable: validated mirror run at 50K calls, p95 target met for selected endpoints
3) Pilot (6 weeks) — owner: Priya / Monica — start: 2027-10-18 — deliverable: production mirror at 100K calls, cost cap enforced, telemetry dashboard live
4) Contracting & procurement sign-off — owner: Rahul / Priyom — due: 2027-11-01 — deliverable: signed SOW + PO or committed purchase order
5) Production rollout & SLA handover — owner: Priya — due: 2027-11-15 — deliverable: production traffic transition & SLA doc

Acceptance criteria highlights
- Pilot must meet p95 latency target for the top three customer-facing endpoints; we will publish the p95 figures in the pilot report.
- Monthly unit cost variance must be <= 20% during pilot window (measured weekly).
- Security review: SOC2 Q&A completed and any required compensating controls documented prior to pilot start.

Next actions (immediate)
- Arjun: confirm Rahul’s email and procurement cadence (reply-all).
- Priya / Rahul: confirm whether an NDA is required before mirrored traffic PoC.
- Priyom: draft SOW with capped pilot pricing; Monica will populate acceptance criteria column.
- Sergio: I’ll upload the checklist to the HubSpot deal and share the Drive folder link once we have Rahul’s procurement timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.
